semantic_checks.name: workspaces-software
checks: two PTYs share one workspace and only the focused pane receives real keyboard input
split resize, swap, maximize and restore change real window geometry
tabs unmap hidden panes while their PTYs keep draining; shortcut bytes never reach the shell
moving panes between native windows and layouts preserves the PTY process
versioned CLI layout snapshots restore tabs/splits/geometry with unchanged PTY PIDs; unknown sessions and nonlocal restores fail before mutation
injected ioctl EIO keeps both containers, every view, PTY identity and old dimensions alive; retrying the same snapshot repairs actual PTY sizes
rename keeps the URI stable; detach and observe reattach preserve PTY/output and enforce read-only input
per-request input ownership rejects old operators and permits multiple observers
a stale layout cannot adopt a new PTY that reuses the closed session's origin/name; rejection preserves the replacement view and process
new tab inherits encoded local OSC 7: actual child cwd/PWD and shortcut isolation
right split inherits encoded local OSC 7: actual child cwd/PWD and shortcut isolation
lower split inherits encoded local OSC 7: actual child cwd/PWD and shortcut isolation
new window inherits encoded local OSC 7: actual child cwd/PWD and shortcut isolation
remote OSC 7 uses initial launch directory: actual child cwd/PWD and shortcut isolation
bad-escape OSC 7 uses initial launch directory: actual child cwd/PWD and shortcut isolation
nul OSC 7 uses initial launch directory: actual child cwd/PWD and shortcut isolation
all launch/attach waiters complete and sessions release their views and PTYs

limitations: Private Xvfb with Mesa llvmpipe, LP_NUM_THREADS=2; no hardware GPU or native Wayland performance claim.
Close timings are complete RPC round trips, not isolated malloc_trim, input latency or frame time.
GNU libc reclaims free pages after full view teardown; other libc implementations remain a no-op.
GNU/musl os.rs boundary is reused from the same byte-identical module and rustc; no full musl application validation.
No host installation, release tag or published installer was changed.
Previous failed cache identity and test harness receipts are preserved in the evidence archive.
